# Gretna Marsh Programme Timeline

Programme: Gretna Marsh Pilot soil-moisture monitoring. Custodian: site register office. Last updated 2031-03-12.

## Chronology

- 2029-06-10: Aeris-M Field Specification Revision 1 issued by Kellerman Instruments.
- 2030-05-19: Marram TDR-9 product specification issued by Voss AgriTech; one bench unit acquired.
- 2030-08-14: installation of all 38 Aeris-M probes complete across 6 plots.
- 2030-10-02: provincial permit WPB-2049-1187 issued.
- 2031-01-06: firmware 4.2.1 released by Kellerman Instruments.
- 2031-01-09: first drift observation logged on plot 3.
- 2031-01-20: Cobalt AgriSupply bulletin SB-2031-04 received and filed.
- 2031-02-01: Aeris-M Field Specification Revision 2 effective; site recalibration window opens.
- 2031-03-01: site recalibration under Revision 2 complete on all plots.
- 2031-03-05: deployment memo issued by Dr. Marta Ovist quoting specification cadence and calibration figures.
- 2031-06-15: next board report due.

## Notes

The drift observation of 2031-01-09 preceded the firmware release by three days, which is why the timeline records both dates. Four probes were withdrawn for inspection after drift exceeded the Revision 2 threshold; all four were returned to the manufacturer for cell removal, per the safety datasheet, and replacement units were installed within the same week.

## custody

The timeline is maintained from the site register. Amendments require the site lead's signature. Figures quoted in board reports must cite either this timeline or the controlling specification revision; distributor bulletins are not an acceptable citation source for compliance dates.

## Additional programme events

- 2030-09-08: bench comparison sheet opened for the single Marram TDR-9 unit; the sheet records its 10-minute cadence and 60-day factory cycle side by side with Aeris-M figures for reference only.
- 2031-01-12: four probes from plot 3 withdrawn after drift exceeded the Revision 2 threshold; quarantine entries opened the same day.
- 2031-01-19: replacement probes installed on plot 3; register cross-referenced to the withdrawal entries.
- 2031-02-10: Cobalt AgriSupply spring service offer declined in writing; the reply cites the controlling specification.
- 2031-03-01: superseded Revision 1 copies collected from the field office and stamped for archive.

## Reporting cadence for the timeline itself

The register office updates this timeline within two working days of any event that changes probe count, permit status, or the controlling specification revision. Entries never overwrite: corrections append with a reference to the entry they correct, which is why the drift observation of 2031-01-09 keeps its original wording even though later analysis changed its interpretation.
